2608.02444.title: ParEvalLayer: When Partial LLM-Agent Evaluations Support a Decision
2608.02444.paper_summary: LLM-agent evaluations often produce task outcomes long before the full benchmark run is complete. A partial score is tempting to report, but it does not show whether the observed tasks support the same conclusion as the completed evaluation. Early tasks can omit important parts of a benchmark, running cheaper tasks first can distort the observed sample, and a rule that decides only easy pairs can appear accurate while leaving many comparisons unresolved. We introduce ParEvalLayer, a decision layer that reads paired outcomes for two agent systems and a comparison policy chosen in advance. For each partial run, it records whether the tested agent system is better by the required amount, is not better by that amount, needs more evidence, or should abstain. We evaluate ParEvalLayer by replaying completed public benchmark data as if each evaluation had stopped earlier. At each point, ParEvalLayer applies the policy using only the outcomes observed so far; if it reaches one of the two comparison judgments, we check whether that judgment matches the completed data for the same system pair. With the main comparison rule, three of the public benchmarks reach the same decision as the completed evaluation after observing only 15% to 25% of task outcomes. Other benchmarks require more task outcomes. This variation shows why a partial score alone is not enough: reports should also state the decision rule and how many comparisons remain without a decision.
2608.02444.paper_summary_zh: LLM-agent 評估通常在完整基準運行完成之前就產生任務結果。報告部分分數是誘人的，但它並不顯示觀察到的任務是否支持與完成評估相同的結論。早期任務可能省略基準的重要部分，先運行較便宜的任務可能會扭曲觀察到的樣本，而僅決定簡單配對的規則可能看起來準確，但會留下許多比較未解決。我們介紹 ParEvalLayer，一個決策層，該層針對兩個代理系統的配對結果和提前選擇的比較政策進行讀取。對於每個部分運行，它記錄測試的代理系統是否比所需的量更好，是否不如該量好，是否需要更多證據，或應該放棄。我們通過重播已完成的公共基準數據來評估 ParEvalLayer，彷彿每次評估都提前停止。在每個點上，ParEvalLayer 僅使用到目前為止觀察到的結果應用政策；如果它達到兩個比較判斷之一，我們檢查該判斷是否與相同系統配對的完成數據匹配。使用主要比較規則，三個公共基準在僅觀察到 15% 到 25% 的任務結果後達成與完成評估相同的決策。其他基準則需要更多的任務結果。這種變化顯示為什麼單獨的部分分數是不夠的：報告還應該說明決策規則以及還有多少比較未做出決策。
2608.02444.author: Wei-Jung Huang et.al.
